description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Front Bumper Bar Cross Member.
This is what the Front Bumper attaches to.
Comes with the LH & RH Bumper Attachment Plates
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Cross Member, Front Bumper
Qty 1 – RH Bumper Attachment Plate
Qty 1 – LH Bumper Attachment Plate
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
